name: bee-fast-video
description: Speed up, slow down and control any video on any site.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:chrome && npm run test:e2e:firefox
scripts.test:e2e:chrome: wxt build && vitest run --dir e2e --exclude screenshots.test.ts --testTimeout 30000 --hookTimeout 60000
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: wxt build -b firefox && E2E_BROWSER=firefox vitest run --dir e2e --exclude screenshots.test.ts --testTimeout 30000 --hookTimeout 60000
scripts.e2e:install: browsers install chrome@stable --path .cache/browsers && browsers install firefox@stable --path .cache/browsers
